body: 多层折叠纸雕弹出书，2:3竖幅，正面略俯视角。打开的书页呈现一座森林小屋与跨溪木桥，两棵高树、狐狸和小蘑菇依纸层错落站立。真实折痕、纸纤维和插接结构，鲜艳梦幻配色，柔光形成层间阴影。保持确切的书页基座和剪纸材质，不做塑料玩具，不加文字。

en.title: Folded paper forest pop-up book
en.description: An open book supports layered paper trees, a cottage, fox and stream bridge. Paper grain, tabs, folds and layer shadows are visible.

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. This example uses no reference image.
